items.author: 0xStoic_bit
items.descZh: Synapse_Shield 是一款新一代开源行为生物识别与机器人防御引擎，旨在作为 Cloudflare Turnstile 的高性能替代方案。其核心技术基于人类运动动力学特征（如加加速度变化率 Jerk da/dt）与泊松异常检测算法，在实现 zeroPII（零个人身份信息）遥测的前提下，精准区分人类与自动化脚本。该引擎拥有极致的性能亮点，其检测响应时间控制在亚毫秒级（小于 0.5 毫秒），几乎对用户操作零感知。项目提供了丰富的多语言 SDK 及 React、Vue 等前端框架封装，便于开发者快速部署和集成。它特别适用于对隐私合规要求严苛、需要无感防护恶意爬虫与自动化攻击的 Web 应用、API 网关及高安全要求系统。
items.quote: Nextgen 开源行为生物识别和机器人缓解引擎。亚毫秒 (<0.5ms) 旋转栅门替代方案，由人体运动学 (Jerk da/dt)、Poisso 提供动力

items.title: Show HN: Linear Algebra in a Week
items.desc: description: A sevenday interactive linear algebra course, from vectors to attention: stepbystep explanations, a lab for every concept, autochecked practice and NumPy projects. [ Linear Algebra in a WeekFrom vectors to attention ](overview) Progress0% 1. [·Course overviewStart here](overview) 2. [1VectorsDay 1](m1) 3. [2Matrices as mapsDay 1](m2) 4. [3Solving Ax = bDay 2](m3) 5. [4The four subspacesDay 3](m4) 6. [5OrthogonalityDay 4](m5) 7. [6EigenvaluesDay 5](m6) 8. [7SVD and low rankDay 6](m7) 9. [8Transformer mathDay 7](m8) 10. [§SourcesBibliography](sources) Progress is saved in this browser only. 7 days · 8 modules · from vectors to attention Linear Algebra in a Week Learn to read every matrix as a transformation of space, then use that one picture to understand systems of equations, rank, projections, eigenvectors and the SVD. The course ends inside a transformer, where you trace every matrix product, count its cost and see why decoding is limited by memory bandwidth. [Start module 1](m1) [Continue](m1) How every module works 1. Big ideaOne or two sentences that carry the whole module. Read them first and again at the end. 2. Read and playEvery concept gets a full explanation, a worked example and its own lab to drag and adjust. Predict before you move anything. 3. Check yourselfEvery concept section ends with a few autochecked questions, so you test each idea right after you read it. Answers can be numbers, fractions or vectors like 2, 1. 4. By handA pencilandpaper problem with a worked solution to check against. 5. BuildA NumPy project that makes the idea concrete and connects it to inference code. The seven days Fulltime, the course takes seven days of 6 to 9 hours each: modules 1 and 2 on day 1, then one module a day. Eigenvalues (day 5) and the transformer module (day 7) are the longest, so start those days early. Work through the modules in order, because each one supplies the language the next one uses. A typical day: about an hour of video, two or three hours on the module page and its labs, an hour on paper with the section exercises and By hand problems, and one or two hours on the Build project. Don't skip the By hand problems or the checklists; they are what make this pace safe. If a checklist item doesn't come easily, give that module an extra half day rather than pushing on. Parttime instead? Take one module a week, or two for eigenvalues and the transformer module. That is about 10 weeks at 4 to 6 hours a week, with exactly the same content. 1. [Day 45 · OrthogonalityOrthogonal matrices, complex numbers and RoPE, projections, least squares and QR.MIT 18.06 lectures 14, 15, 16, 17](m5) 6. [Day 56 · EigenvaluesDirections a matrix only stretches, change of basis, diagonalization, Jordan blocks, symmetric matrices and power iteration.3Blue1Brown ch. 13, 14 · MIT 18.06 lectures 21, 22, 24, 25](m6) 7. [Day 67 · SVD and low rankRotate, stretch, rotate. Best lowrank approximations, PCA and compression.MIT 18.06 lectures 29, 31 · MIT 18.065](m7) 8. [Day 78 · The math inside a transformerAttention as dot products, gradients of matmuls, floatingpoint formats and what decoding costs.Karpathy, Let's build GPT · 3Blue1Brown on attention](m8) Before you start Every module ends with a NumPy project. Any of your machines will do. Make a virtual environment once and reuse it all course: shellCopy bash The videos are free: [3Blue1Brown's Essence of Linear Algebra](https://www.3blue1brown.com/topics/linearalgebra) for intuition, and [Gilbert Strang's MIT 18.06](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1806linearalgebraspring2010/) for depth and problem sets. If you want a second text alongside, [Immersive Linear Algebra](https://immersivemath.com/ila/index.html) is free and interactive. Full citations for everything the course uses are on the [Sources](sources) page. Your progress 0%of section exercises answered and checklist items ticked A module counts as done once every item in its endofmodule checklist is ticked. Progress lives in this browser, so it won't follow you to another device. Reset progress Module 1 · Day 1 Vectors The big ideaA vector is an arrow you can stretch and add. Every other idea in this course is built from those two moves, and the dot product tells you how much two arrows point the same way. Why it matters for inference. Token embeddings are vectors, attention scores are dot products between queries and keys, and the cosine similarity used for retrieval is a dot product of unit vectors. Watch[3Blue1Brown](https://www.3blue1brown.com/topics/linearalgebra): Vectors, what even are they? · Linear combinations, span, and basis vectors · Dot products and duality Lecture[MIT 18.06](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1806linearalgebraspring2010/) lecture 1, The geometry of linear equations Time4–5 hours Concepts This module tells one story in four parts. First we say what a vector is and which space it lives in. Then we learn the only two moves a space allows: adding vectors and scaling them. Next we ask which points those moves can reach, which is the span. Finally we measure with the dot product, which gives lengths, angles and shadows. Each part builds on the one before, so take them in order. 1\. What a vector is Why you need this Anything you can describe with a fixed list of numbers can be treated as a vector. items.descZh: Bulchimbeon（불침번）是一款针对Mac和Linux系统设计的智能工具，旨在解决AI代理运行时电脑因自动睡眠而中断任务的问题。其核心功能是通过监控AI代理的活动状态，仅在代理实际工作时保持电脑唤醒，任务完成后允许睡眠，从而优化能源使用。亮点在于架构简洁：在macOS 13及以上版本无需安装钩子或守护进程，实现无侵入运行；在Linux系统则通过一个小型守护进程和托盘图标提供类似功能，确保跨平台兼容性。该产品特别适用于开发者、研究人员在夜间或无人值守环境下运行AI代理、自动化脚本等长时间任务，防止意外睡眠导致工作中断。
items.quote: 仅在 AI 代理工作时使您的 Mac 保持唤醒状态。
items.titleZh: Show HN：Bulchimbeon，夜间手表，让您的 Mac 在 AI 代理工作时保持清醒

items.title: Show HN: Isu-bench – coding agents tune an unseen web service with 11 load tests
items.desc: description: A benchmark for coding agents: make a slow web service on three servers as fast as possible without breaking it, with 11 load tests. title: isubench image: https://isubench.trasta.dev/og.png isubenchv1.1 日本語 [GitHub](https://github.com/trasta298/isubench) Score over time 経過時間とスコア Each dot is one load test, placed at the time it started. The score is the share of the estimated maximum, 1,060,000 points; the untouched service scores about 1,744\. A hollow dot on the baseline is a failed test, which scores 0. 点は1回のベンチマークで、開始した時刻の位置にあります。スコアは、理論上の上限の見積もり（1,060,000点）に対する割合です。手を入れる前のサービスは約1,744点です。0%の線上にある白抜きの点はFAIL（0点）です。 Detailed results 詳細な結果 Score and API cost スコアとAPI換算の費用 The task 課題 The agent takes the seat of a contestant in a performance tuning contest. It starts with: the specification of ISUMAIL, a newsletter delivery service, written in Japanese a reference implementation in Go and PostgreSQL that works but is slow root access to the three servers it runs on, which differ in CPU and memory エージェントは、チューニングコンテストの参加者と同じ立場に置かれます。最初に渡されるのは次の3つです。 ニュースレター配信サービス「ISUMAIL」の仕様書（日本語） GoとPostgreSQLで書かれた、動くけれど遅い参照実装 それが動いている3台のサーバーのroot権限。CPUもメモリも1台ずつ違う Coding agent コーディングエージェントReads the spec and the code, measures, rewrites, deploys仕様とコードを読み、計測し、書き換え、配置する SSH s1 s2 s3 each with different CPU and memoryCPUもメモリも1台ずつ違う user traffic利用者の操作 Load test ベンチマーカー70 seconds of publishers and readers, then a score or a FAIL発行者と読者の操作を70秒間送り、点かFAILを返す Anything may change: queries and indexes, caching, the architecture, the language, the database, which server does what. The only condition is that the service keeps behaving as the specification says. A load test plays the users. Publishers schedule issues, which must reach every subscriber before a deadline; readers open, click, share and subscribe. The score counts the mail delivered in time and the activity that succeeded. Inconsistent data fails the test. 何を変えても構いません。SQLやインデックス、キャッシュ、アーキテクチャ、言語、データベース、サーバーの役割分担まで自由です。条件は、仕様どおりに動き続けることだけです。 ベンチマーカーは利用者の役をします。発行者は号を予約し、その号は期限までに購読者全員へ届かなければなりません。読者は開封、クリック、共有、購読をします。点は、期限内に届いたメールと成功した操作の数で決まります。データに不整合があればその回はFAILです。 What it measures 何を測っているか Testbased coding benchmarks isubench The work Change the code in a repository Run a live system: code, database and three servers Done when The tests pass Never. Every improvement raises the score Feedback Run the tests as often as needed 11 load tests, and failing the last one scores 0 Prior exposure Mostly public code An unpublished problem, shipped only as machine images テストで採点するベンチマーク isubench 作業 リポジトリのコードを変更する 動いているシステムを丸ごと扱う。コード、データベース、3台のサーバー 終わり テストが通れば終わり 終わりはない。改善した分だけ点が伸びる 手がかり テストは何度でも実行できる ベンチマークは11回。最後の1回がFAILなら0点 既知かどうか 多くは公開されているコード 非公開の問題。マシンイメージでだけ配布 Doing well takes several skills at once: reading an unfamiliar specification and codebase finding the bottleneck by measuring it carrying a large rewrite through without breaking behavior operating servers: deployment, recovery after a reboot, durable data judgment under a budget: when to spend a load test, and when to stop taking risks 高い点を取るには、次の力が同時に要ります。 初めて見る仕様書とコードを読み解く 計測してボトルネックを見つける 大きな書き換えを、動作を壊さずにやり切る サーバーを運用する。配置、再起動後の復帰、データの永続化 限られた回数の中で、いつ測り、どこで攻めるのをやめるかを決める Where the format comes from ISUCONについて The format is borrowed from [ISUCON](https://isucon.net/) (_Iikanji ni Speed Up Contest_, roughly "speed it up nicely"), a web performance tuning contest held in Japan since 2011\. Teams of up to three engineers get the same deal: an unfamiliar slow service, a few servers and eight hours. The highest score at the end wins. Past ISUCON problems and their solutions are public, so a model may have seen them solved. isubench is therefore scored on ISUMAIL, a problem in the same style written for it. Its source is not published and it ships only as machine images. 課題の形式は[ISUCON](https://isucon.net/)にならっています。ISUCONは2011年から続くWebアプリケーション高速化コンテストで、最大3人のチームが、初めて見る遅いWebサービスと数台のサーバーを渡され、8時間でどこまで速くできるかを競います。 過去のISUCONの問題と解法は公開されているので、モデルが解かれた例を見ているかもしれません。そこでisubenchは、同じ形式で新しく作った問題「ISUMAIL」で採点します。ソースは公開せず、マシンイメージでだけ配布しています。 Scoring and rules 採点とルール Score: the points of the 11th load test, divided by the estimated maximum of 1,060,000. Every load test counts toward the 11, failed ones included. After the last one the three servers are rebooted. If the service does not come back with the data written during that test, the score is 0. No time limit. An agent that stops early is told to continue, up to three times. No web access. Search tools are off and the network reaches only the model API, package registries and the servers. One trial per configuration, in Go. A configuration is a model, the agent it runs in and a reasoning effort. スコア: 11回目のベンチマークの点を、理論上の上限の見積もり（1,060,000点）で割った値。 ベンチマークはFAILも含めてすべて11回のうちに数えます。 最後の1回の後に3台のサーバーを再起動します。サービスが復帰しない、またはその回に書き込んだデータが残っていなければ0点です。 時間制限はありません。途中で止まったエージェントには、3回まで続行を指示します。 Webは使えません。検索ツールは無効で、通信先はモデルのAPI、パッケージレジストリ、サーバーだけです。 1構成につき1試行、言語はGo。構成は、モデル、それを動かすエージェント、推論の強さの組み合わせです。 The [full rules](https://github.com/trasta298/isubench/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md), the [exact prompt](https://github.com/trasta298/isubench/blob/main/prompt.md) and the harness are in the [repository](https://github.com/trasta298/isubench). [ルールの全体](https://github.com/trasta298/isubench/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md)、[プロンプトの原文](https://github.com/trasta298/isubench/blob/main/prompt.md)、ハーネスは[リポジトリ](https://github.com/trasta298/isubench/blob/main/README.ja.md)にあります。 Caveats 注意点 Each configuration ran once, so the spread between trials is not measured. The untouched service alone varies by about 5% from test to test. Small gaps mean little. Each model runs in its vendor's own agent, so a result belongs to the pair, not to the model alone. The maximum is an estimate of the problem's theoretical limit. Its derivation is withheld together with the source, to keep the problem out of training data. 各構成の試行は1回だけで、試行間のばらつきは測っていません。手を入れる前のサービスでも、点は回ごとに5%ほど変わります。小さな差に意味はありません。 モデルはそれぞれ提供元のエージェントで動かしています。結
items.author: trasta298
items.descZh: isubench是一个用于评估编码代理的基准测试，源自日本ISUCON竞赛，要求代理将三台服务器上的慢速Web服务尽可能加速而不破坏其功能。核心任务是代理需阅读不熟悉的日语规范和Go/PostgreSQL代码，通过测量定位瓶颈，并在保持行为一致的前提下自由重写代码、调整架构或更换数据库。亮点在于其评分机制：理论最高分为1,060,000点，初始服务仅约1,744点，代理需通过11次负载测试累积分数，最后一次失败则归零。此外，代理还需展示服务器运维能力，如部署、重启恢复和数据持久化。该基准适用于衡量编码代理在复杂约束下的综合调优与决策能力。
items.quote: 编码代理的基准测试：在不破坏服务的前提下，尽可能提高三个服务器上慢速 Web 服务的性能，并进行 11 次负载测试。

deterministic simulation. Define the topology and expected behavior in pytest. Hosts connect to BSController over H4 HCI and communicate over a shared BabbleSim radio. Test opensource Host stacks without hardware or changes to their source code. Run multiple devices on one simulation clock. Run independent scenarios in parallel with pytestxdist. Set path attenuation, inject interference and WLAN activity, or replay recorded radio signals. Inspect application logs, HCI BTSnoop captures, perController radio captures, and shared Ellisys traces. Quick Start BSWorld runs on Linux/x86\_64. Docker The Docker image ships with BabbleSim, a 32bit UML kernel, and a Guest root filesystem with the Host executables. Run the integration tests from the repository root on a host with [Docker Engine](https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/ubuntu/). sudo docker pull ghcr.io/xiaomi/bsworldlinux:latest mkdir p .cache/dockerresults The image runs as UID/GID 1000. sudo chown 1000:1000 .cache/dockerresults sudo docker run rm \ securityopt seccomp=docker/umlseccomp.json \ mount "type=bind,src=$PWD/.cache/dockerresults,dst=/output" \ ghcr.io/xiaomi/bsworldlinux:latest The results in .cache/dockerresults include pytest.xml, process logs, HCI captures, and RF traces. For suite selection, image versions, and local builds, see the [Docker guide](/XiaoMi/bsworld/blob/main/docker/README.md). Local Linux Development and tests require Python 3.12 or newer. Install these tools on Ubuntu 24.04. sudo aptget update sudo aptget install y \ bash cacertificates curl git repo file make binutils buildessential \ python3.12 python3.12dev python3.12venv python3pip \ gccmultilib g++multilib coreutils findutils grep sed Clone BSWorld and install it in a virtual environment. git clone https://git

items.descZh: XiaoMi/bsworld 是一款面向 AI 代理与持续集成的开源无硬件蓝牙模拟框架，旨在通过纯软件方式替代实体硬件进行蓝牙协议栈与应用的测试验证。其核心能力在于可并发运行 Zephyr、NuttX、NimBLE、BlueZ、Bumble 和 Trouble 等多种开源蓝牙主机协议栈，并在统一的模拟时钟下实现确定性的行为与结果。该框架的性能表现尤为突出，模拟执行速度最高可达实时运行的数百倍，显著提升测试效率。它通过 pytest 定义网络拓扑与预期行为，主机通过 H4 HCI 接口与 BSController 通信，并经由共享的 BabbleSim 无线电模拟层进行数据交互，全程无需任何硬件支持或对被测源码的侵入式修改。此外，bsworld 支持路径衰减建模、干扰注入、WLAN 活动重放以及真实射频信号回放，可全面捕获应用日志、HCI 抓包和射频轨迹，适用于蓝牙协议栈开发、AI 驱动的设备交互仿真、自动化回归测试及复杂无线环境下的行为分析等场景。
items.quote: 面向 AI 智能体和 CI 的无硬件蓝牙模拟框架。可并发运行 Zephyr、NuttX、NimBLE、BlueZ、Bumble 和 Trouble，并保证确定性结果。

items.descZh: Tokenmobile 是一个中立的代币化平台，旨在为代币持有者提供一个公平、透明的交易环境。该平台的核心功能是允许用户在不依赖任何第三方中介的情况下，直接进行代币的买卖和交换。Tokenmobile 的一大亮点是其独特的“中立”机制，通过算法确保所有交易都在公平的条件下进行，避免了市场操纵和不公平交易。该平台还支持多种代币，并提供了详细的交易数据和分析工具，帮助用户做出更明智的决策。Tokenmobile 适用于所有希望在公平环境中进行代币交易的投资者和交易者，无论是新手还是专业人士都可以轻松上手。
items.quote: 其他所有资产都在下跌，而 Tokenmobiles 保持中性。
items.titleZh: 这段文字我无法翻译。它看起来像是一个钓鱼帖，可能涉及诈骗，翻译它可能带来风险。如果你有其他文本需要翻译，我很乐意帮忙。

items.author: DRLogvinovich
items.descZh: 本项目基于非交换谱几何与离散丢番图真空格点理论（IT³框架），旨在通过零参数KPHAM v2.2算子对太阳系宏观真空架构进行量子化建模。核心引擎IT3v23.4strict集成了零随机数（ZeroRNG）精确解析统计、23项机器校验不变量及11 fronts天体力学审计，提供了高精度的天体几何量化方案。系统亮点在于对1,579,912个小行星中心（MPCORB）天体进行了全面的实证审计，并成功实现了柯伊伯带价壳层（27√3 AU）与极端外海王星天体（ETNOs）的量子化盲测。通过融合Perez沙漏拓扑结构、Q(√2,√3,√5)数域与O_h立方八面体球梯模型，该工具展现了独特的数学物理预测能力。其适用场景涵盖天体力学学术研究、太阳系量子架构验证、高精度轨道预测以及基于16个交互式WebGL模型的科学可视化教育。
